summary: Comprehensive testing of Vendor Portfolio feature completed. Backend: 10/10 tests passed. Frontend: All UI elements verified - Admin Dashboard shows Portfolio section with Upload Photos button, VendorProfileView shows read-only portfolio gallery with AI-detected tags.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/vendors/{vendor_id}/portfolio correctly returns portfolio items publicly without auth
POST /api/vendor/portfolio with admin token and vendor_id query param correctly creates portfolio for specified vendor
DELETE /api/vendor/portfolio/{portfolio_id} with admin token correctly deletes any portfolio item
PUT /api/vendor/portfolio/{portfolio_id} with admin token correctly updates any portfolio item
Admin Dashboard > Vendors tab > Click vendor shows Portfolio section with Upload Photos button
VendorPortfolio component correctly uses targetVendorId and isAdmin props for admin management
VendorProfileView page shows read-only portfolio gallery with AI-detected tags (no edit/delete buttons)
Portfolio cards display AI-detected tags: part_category, manufacturing_process, material, surface_finish, complexity
seed_data_creation: Used existing vendor portfolio data - vendor_68cfbaafb999 has 1 portfolio item with AI-detected tags
